summary: Iteration 3 regression retest for the two CRITICAL bugs from iteration_2. Both fixes verified: (1) recovery-code login now returns 200 + {recovery_used: true} and reuse of the same code returns 401 'Invalid 2FA code'; (2) POST /api/drivers with email='' now returns 200 (empty-string coerced to None), and posts without an email field also succeed. All 25 pytest cases PASS (previously 23 with 2 CRITICAL). Admin 2FA is DISABLED at end of run (test's finally block executed).
